title: Dataform adds GitRepositoryLink for machine credentials
summary: Dataform now supports linking Git repository resources for machine credentials, simplifying authentication for automated workflows.
details: A new optional field `gitRepositoryLink` has been added to the `GitRemoteSettings` schema. This allows developers to point to a managed Git repository resource (format: `projects/*/locations/*/connections/*/gitRepositoryLinks/*`) instead of manually managing secrets for machine-based Git operations. This likely integrates with Google Cloud's Developer Connect for more secure and centralized credential management.
